visionLayer.referenceOnlyPolicy: No sample under images/reference/original or images/reference/crops may enter a supervised training split unless a reviewed annotation explicitly changes trainingEligible to true and all source-group/split gates pass.

miteOrInsect: host damage paired with organism evidence where possible
fungalOrRootPathogen: culture, microscopy, molecular identification, or pathogenicity evidence appropriate to the claim
virusViroidPhytoplasma: PCR/RT-PCR/sequence or other accepted molecular confirmation
abioticStress: measured environmental/root-zone exposure linked to the photographed plant

doNotUseAsTrainingGroundTruth: whole scientific composites containing multiple labels
same-source panels split across train and evaluation
cross-crop plant-disease images relabeled as Cannabis
single photographs used to claim laboratory-dependent diseases
unlockProcedure: ingest a rights-cleared sample with full annotation schema
rebuild splits by source group and rerun readiness validation
